title: File card: name and size, readable by the bot
gate: Gate A oracle-file-sent 54/54 (the file card: card#3, 10 parts; scripts/lib/cards.mjs), oracle-file-waiting 47/47 (the file waiting in the composer)
evidence: The sent card looks as the oracle's 1.0.3 card (fixtures/states/oracle-file-sent, a version exception, docs/decisions/0008): components/Cards.tsx FileCard + styles/cards.css, in a row of its own above the message's bubble: 300 x 72 on rgb 37, radius 22, a page mark (a sheet with four lines), the name (its kind kept apart so a long name loses its middle) and the size. A message carries it as Bubble.files. Pictures only can be sent: Composer.tsx takes up to four pictures (Attach files in the composer menu, or a paste), stored for the conversation and named by id (chat/api.ts uploadPicture, sendMessage); the bot's computer fetches them for claude. Live: npm run turn:live -- --picture (2026-11-13; parity/live/picture.json). scripts/behaviour.mjs: 3 rules. Missing: files that are not pictures (Barkpark stores png, jpeg, gif and webp only; decision task-b47b4dcd04d7e4de), so no live message carries a file card yet; opening a file from its card. Waiting, a file sits inside the composer above the words as the oracle's does (components/Attachments.tsx: half the row, 56 tall, page mark, name, size, a Remove button; the box grows to 136, radius 18), but only a gate scene can hold one, since the composer still refuses files that are not pictures.
